_comment: read.c seffect_amnesia() reads Hallucination, which hallucination resistance makes false. A lawful dwarvish Valkyrie quaffs a potion of hallucination, then wields Grayswandir (EHalluc_resistance) and reads a scroll of amnesia, so C prints one of its two Maud lines rather than "Your mind releases itself from mundane concerns."
